title: Batch image compress / convert input
description: Provide image URLs and/or an upstream Apify dataset / KV store (compatible with batch-image-downloader output fields: sourceUrl, kvKey). Re-encodes to WebP/JPEG/PNG (AVIF is runtime optional / currently unavailable on this runtime). Optional EXIF strip. Batch optimization pipeline — not site crawling or img scraping.

imageUrls.title: Image URLs
imageUrls.description: Direct image URLs to download and compress. Accepts strings, {"url": "..."}, or requestListSources-style entries. Deduplicated, order preserved. No page crawl — pass image URLs only.

sourceDatasetId.title: Source dataset ID
sourceDatasetId.description: Optional Apify dataset ID (e.g. from batch-image-downloader). Reads image URLs from each item via imageUrlField (default sourceUrl, then url). If sourceKvStoreId is also set and items have kvKey, prefers KV bytes over re-download.

sourceKvStoreId.title: Source KV store ID
sourceKvStoreId.description: Optional key-value store ID holding already-downloaded images. Used with sourceDatasetId rows that include kvKey, or with kvKeyPrefix to list matching keys.

imageUrlField.title: Dataset URL field
imageUrlField.description: Field name on sourceDatasetId items that holds the image URL. Default sourceUrl (batch-image-downloader). Falls back to url / imageUrl.

kvKeyField.title: Dataset KV key field
kvKeyField.description: Field on sourceDatasetId items naming the binary in sourceKvStoreId. Default kvKey.

targetFormat.title: Target format
targetFormat.description: Output image format. avif is used when the runtime supports it; otherwise the run marks those rows as error (free) unless you choose another format. keep = same family as source (jpeg/png/webp) with re-encode.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Quality 1–95 for WebP / JPEG / AVIF (ignored for PNG).

maxWidth.title: Max width (px)
maxWidth.description: If > 0, downscale so width ≤ this (keeps aspect ratio). 0 = no resize.

maxHeight.title: Max height (px)
maxHeight.description: If > 0, downscale so height ≤ this (keeps aspect ratio). 0 = no resize.

stripExif.title: Strip EXIF / GPS
stripExif.description: Remove EXIF and GPS metadata from the output (privacy). On by default for convert mode.

stripOnly.title: Strip-only (no re-encode)
stripOnly.description: When on, only strip metadata and re-save in the source format (cheaper image-strip-only event). Ignores targetFormat / quality / resize.

maxImages.title: Max images
maxImages.description: Stop after processing this many unique images (0 = no limit). Caps cost.

maxBytesPerImage.title: Max bytes per source image
maxBytesPerImage.description: Skip (free) sources larger than this many bytes. Default 15 MB.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel downloads / converts. Keep moderate to stay within 256–512 MB.

minDelayMsPerHost.title: Min delay per host (ms)
minDelayMsPerHost.description: Minimum milliseconds between starting downloads to the same host. 0 = no extra delay.

skipDuplicatesByHash.title: Skip duplicate output (sha256)
skipDuplicatesByHash.description: If on, identical output bytes after the first success are recorded as status=duplicate (free) and not re-stored.

kvKeyPrefix.title: KV key prefix
kvKeyPrefix.description: Prefix for stored file keys, e.g. opt- → opt-<sha256>.<ext>. Only a-zA-Z0-9!-_.'() allowed (no slashes).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy. Off by default — use only when sources require it.

chargeFailedImages.title: Charge failed images
chargeFailedImages.description: When off (default), only successful KV stores are charged. Failed/non-image/oversized/duplicate rows are saved free.
